name: Ajinkya Rahane
why_target: Premier replacement for Sanju Samson at No. 3. Stabilizes early collapse, anchors while Jaiswal/Parag attack, and provides veteran captaincy support.
risks: Susceptible to express 150kph hard-length bowling if required run rate crosses 12 early.

name: Nitish Rana
why_target: Elite middle-overs spin destructor. Smashes wrist-spin and SLA at 155+ SR, balancing RR middle order alongside Parag and Jurel.
risks: Occasional vulnerability to back-of-a-length seam in powerplays.

name: Nehal Wadhera
why_target: High-ceiling young Indian left-handed finisher. Phenomenal composure in death chases (145+ SR), solves RR’s lower-order finishing void.
risks: Still developing consistency against top-tier international mystery spin.

name: Shimron Hetmyer
why_target: Proven Rajasthan Royals match-winner. Re-acquiring him at a rational price after release provides instant death-overs boundary violence.
risks: Utilizes 1 of RR’s 3 remaining overseas slots; price inflation in open bidding.

name: Rahul Tripathi
why_target: Aggressive intent-first Indian No. 3 striker. Takes down pace in powerplays with 140+ SR, allowing Jaiswal to play deep.
risks: High-risk shot selection can result in early dismissal streaks.

name: Mahipal Lomror
why_target: Former RR academy prodigy and explosive left-handed spin enforcer. Cheap domestic middle-order muscle with part-time SLA bowling.
risks: Struggles when denied room outside off against high pace.

name: Abishek Porel
why_target: Dynamic Indian wicketkeeper-batter. Fulfills crucial backup keeper slot for Dhruv Jurel and provides aggressive powerplay hitting.
risks: Relatively small sample size in high-pressure IPL eliminators.

name: Asif Khan
why_target: Unmatched 196.52 pressure strike rate. Ultra-budget overseas power finisher who can turn impossible chases in overs 18–20.
risks: Associate background; untested on turning Chepauk or Lucknow surfaces.

name: Rachin Ravindra
why_target: Elite young multi-format all-rounder. Offers top-order batting elegance plus 4 overs of left-arm orthodox spin on dry Jaipur wickets.
risks: Overseas slot utilization; strike rate deceleration against defensive spin.

name: Fakhar Zaman
why_target: Explosive international enforcer with 183.89 pressure SR. Dismantles express pace in powerplays and steep chases.
risks: Can be tied down by disciplined left-arm finger spin in powerplay.
